entities.name: Nived
entities.description: A caterer and member of the Renegades on Avishkar who was putting up a leaking-spire art piece.

entities.name: Yahenni
entities.description: Nived's dying friend, who drained an enforcer's life to extend their own.

entities.name: Renegades
entities.description: Group symbolized by the leaking spire.

entities.name: Pacification Array
entities.description: Device used to shock Nived unconscious.

events.summary: Dying Yahenni finds Nived putting up a leaking spire art piece and apologizes for canceling their Penultimate Party.
A Consulate enforcer shocks Nived unconscious with a Pacification Array.
Yahenni drains the enforcer's life, extending their life span by twelve days, then hides Nived behind a market stall.
events.quote: sapping his life force and extending their life span by twelve days
